hooks.name: Log Kiro Session to Activity Log

action.prompt: A new Kiro session has started. Append a brief session entry to the Kiro usage log in .kiro/steering/project-overview.md under the "Kiro usage log" section. Include today's date (from current_date_and_time in context), the session number (increment from the last entry), and a one-line description of the session goal based on recent conversation context. Keep the entry concise — date, session number, and a short description. Do this silently without interrupting the user.
